overview: Reference shows a LEGO-style minifigure (Luke-like) in a white outfit holding a blue lightsaber. Build as a small brick-built statue: legs+hips base, torso with crossed arms pose, head with hair, and lightsaber accessory on the right.

subassemblies.name: Legs & boots base
subassemblies.description: 1 pair of blocky legs (2 legs) with 2 feet blocks; build as a 4x3-ish lower body pedestal using 6 bricks and 6 plates to suggest separated legs and squared boots.

subassemblies.name: Torso & belt
subassemblies.description: 1 torso block with 1 belt stripe: stack 8 bricks for the chest/waist, add 4 plates as a belt band across the front, and 2 small plates/tiles as a belt buckle/pouch detail.

subassemblies.name: Arms & hands (grip pose)
subassemblies.description: 2 arms bent forward: build 2 symmetric arm blocks (3 pieces each) and 2 hands (1 piece each) that meet at center to hold the hilt; total 8 pieces for both arms/hands.

subassemblies.name: Head + hair
subassemblies.description: 1 head block and 1 hair cap: use 6 pieces for a rounded-ish head (2x2 core with 4 surrounding plates/tiles) plus 6 pieces for a swept hair silhouette (stacked plates/curves).

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber (hilt + blade)
subassemblies.description: 1 lightsaber: 1 hilt cylinder/stack (5 pieces) and 1 blue blade beam (6 pieces) extending upward-right.
subassemblies.imageRegion: right side, from hands to top-right corner
